scope: Direct raw-to-clean comparison only; the producer self-check was not used as audit evidence.

common: Read CLEANING_CONTRACT.md and every B07 production record.
Recomputed SHA-256 for each selected raw artifact and cleaned guide, resolved every metadata path under this work package, and compared to B07 metadata.
Checked BOM-free UTF-8/LF guide bytes, guide tails, declared version/date or commit, source URL consistency, and absence of visible SMCL/viewer residue.

For command-entry PDFs, independently extracted the full PDF with pdftotext -layout, compared section-token, bracket-token, and prompt/code-line counts against the guide, and checked the first and last substantive units.

For maintainer raw help, directly compared every source title/section sequence, syntax abbreviation/optional notation, option/result table relationships, examples, returned results, links, and final substantive unit after removing only SMCL presentation controls.

Rendered and visually read first, syntax/table, and final pages of the representative high-layout official entries test, twoway, and xtreg; the rendered tables, code blocks, chart-axis text, and final references/footer agree with the guide's source-order text.
